hiring.positions_note: 43 academic teaching competitions were open on the live SGCA listing: 20 in Facultad de Medicina y Ciencias de la Salud, 13 in Ingeniería y Arquitectura, 6 in Educación, and 4 in Economía, Gobierno y Comunicaciones. The accessible public detail form did not expose the individual vacancies or a Medicina/Medicina Interna post without its session-based faculty selection.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: UNKNOWN. The publicly readable detail page states: “Junto a los requisitos que se especifican para cada concurso, es deseable que el o la postulante cuente con formación comprobable en docencia universitaria”. It displayed “No records found” outside the session-based faculty selection; no published requirement concerning foreign degrees, revalidación, or Chilean nationality could be verified. Do not infer that a Chilean title is required from this listing.

international.notes: No official evidence was found that a Medicine subject is delivered in English. The Medicine curriculum includes Inglés I–IV, but the available material does not say that medical content is taught in English. The DRI supports exchange, short international programmes, placements, scholarships, academic activity and research collaboration.

profile_paragraphs: FAMEDSA originated as the Faculty of Health Sciences in 2009. After UCEN approved Medicine in 2023, the unit adopted its current name; its first Medicine cohort began in March 2024.

Medicine is a daytime Santiago programme leading to Licenciado/a en Medicina and Médico/a Cirujano/a. The official programme states a duration of 14 semesters; it therefore remains a new programme without graduating cohorts.

The faculty’s clinical-agreement page lists Hospital Clínico San Borja Arriarán among its hospitals. That hospital’s own current directory lists both adult and paediatric rheumatology, giving a plausible clinical rheumatology contact point rather than a UCEN-run rheumatology department.

On 3 September 2026, UCEN’s academic-teaching competition system listed 20 open competitions in FAMEDSA. The public detail page did not allow verification of individual subjects or foreign-degree requirements, so direct contact before applying is essential.

UCEN’s International Relations Directorate explicitly supports academic and research collaboration, international exchanges and placements. This is relevant to an overseas academic, but it is not evidence of an English-taught medical curriculum or visa sponsorship.

unknowns: A faculty-wide public contact email was not published on the current FAMEDSA pages retrieved; the Medicine page’s email is Cloudflare-obfuscated.
No official evidence was located that Medicine is taught in English; English-language subjects alone do not prove English-medium medical instruction.

The live academic-competition system showed aggregate counts but its public detail view requires a session-based faculty selection. Individual open-course requirements, including title revalidation/nationality rules, could not be read.
No UCEN-run rheumatology department or specialty/beca was found. The verified rheumatology service is at affiliated Hospital Clínico San Borja Arriarán.
